_comment: Project-name watch list — SHA-256 hashes, never plaintext.
See scripts/check-no-project-names.mjs and the AGENTS.md rule. This file is
tracked so the release gate works in CI and for contributors; the plaintext
list stays untracked at .dracon/no-project-names.txt. A one-way hash means
the gate can still catch a leak without this file publishing the names it
Note on hashing: the tokens are short, so this is not a cryptographic
commitment — a determined reader could guess candidates. It removes the
casual inventory (a plain list of the operator's private projects sitting in
a public repo), which is the actual exposure. Do not treat it as a secret.
and append the hex digest to "denied".
